About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer with strong experience to join our growing team and contribute to the development that empowers our organization to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Apply your expertise, technical acumen, and leadership skills to drive innovation and make a significant impact on our business growth.

Key Responsibilities Include:
Design and maintain Automation framework and scripts
Maintain and enhance test automation frameworks using programming languages (Java/Python/JavaScript).
Responsible for creation and implementation of test strategy, test plans, test data for testing.
Conducting and scheduling regression testing using CI/CD pipelines and documenting the results.
Reviewing requirements with Business Analysts and Technical leads
Involve with business and development teams to understand the requirements.
Review design documents for new features and participate in design reviews with the development team.
Involve in Client Engagements to understand the testing scope of the product and release
Preparing Test data by clearly analysing the requirements
Involve in Sprint Backlog refinements / grooming and planning sessions
Developing scenarios and executing automation scripts using automation framework
Implementing and maintaining regression test suite which saves the time for regression testing
Conducting demos to the stakeholders after completing the user stories
Preparation of Test Completion Report, Defect Analysis Report and share with stakeholders

Candidate Qualification:
5 years of experience in software testing as Automation and Functional tester.
Expertise in designing test scripts using Selenium Maven TestNG , Playwright, Cucumber and Rest Assured framework.
Experience in developing test plans, test cases, test data and test reports.
Experience in functional testing, User Acceptance Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing, UI Automation Testing using Java-selenium and Web service Automation using Cucumber and TestNG framework
Extensive experience in SDLC and Agile Process
Designing test cases and test scenarios, conducted functional, ad-hoc and exploratory testing for the variety of applications with expanded test coverage
Experience in working with GitHub as source code management tools
Experience in Bug tracking Tools like JIRA
Effective time management skills – prioritization of tasks and own time by regular follow- up meetings
Ability to remain highly focused and self-motivated in a fast-paced, demand environment.
Critical thinking and analytical skills
Good communication and teamwork skills

Next Steps
If you would like to express interest in the role, please click on the APPLY button now. Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.

result.description:
Title: OutSystems Developer / Consultant
Company: KRE8 IT Pty Ltd
Location: Narre Warren / Melbourne based preferred, with the option to work remotely within Australia. Applicants must be based in Australia due to the regulatory requirements of some of our clients.
Salary: $110,000 - $140,000 per annum, depending on relevant experience
Employment type: Full-time

About KRE8 IT
KRE8 IT is a Melbourne-based technology consulting company specialising in practical software delivery, low-code development, systems integration, and digital transformation. We work with clients to design, build, and support business-critical applications, with a strong focus on governed delivery, maintainable architecture, and high-quality outcomes.
We are seeking an OutSystems Developer / Consultant to support the design, development, implementation, and ongoing improvement of OutSystems applications for our clients.

About the role
The OutSystems Developer / Consultant will work across the full delivery lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, application development, integration, testing, deployment support, and continuous improvement. The role requires strong hands-on OutSystems development capability as well as the ability to work in a consulting environment with clients and internal delivery teams.

Key responsibilities
*   Design, develop, test, and maintain applications using OutSystems.
*   Work with both OutSystems O11 and OutSystems Developer Cloud environments.
*   Translate business requirements into reliable, maintainable application solutions.
*   Develop integrations with external systems, APIs, data services, and business platforms.
*   Support implementation of complex business workflows, decision logic, and rules-driven functionality.
*   Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, designers, analysts, and other developers to deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.
*   Contribute to application architecture, technical design, estimation, documentation, and delivery planning.
*   Troubleshoot, optimise, and improve existing OutSystems applications.
*   Support quality assurance, deployment activities, and production support where required.
*   Apply secure, scalable, and maintainable development practices.

Required experience, qualifications, and skills
*   Minimum 1 year of experience developing applications with OutSystems, including both O11 and ODC.
*   A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field is required. Where the qualification is not directly relevant to the position, the applicant must demonstrate a minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience.
*   Must be based in Australia and able to work with clients operating under Australian regulatory requirements.
*   Strong software development experience, including application design, data modelling, integration, testing, and debugging.
*   Experience working in consulting, client delivery, or project-based software delivery environments.
*   Ability to analyse business requirements and convert them into practical technical solutions.
*   Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
*   Ability to work independently and manage delivery responsibilities with attention to quality and detail.

Highly regarded
*   Demonstrated experience implementing complex decision logic using business rules management systems.
*   Experience implementing applications in the healthcare industry.
*   Working understanding of the FHIR interoperability standard.
*   Experience with API integration, workflow automation, data exchange, and enterprise application integration.
*   Relevant OutSystems certifications.

How to apply
Please apply through this job advertisement platform with your resume and a short cover note outlining your relevant OutSystems experience, including your experience with O11 and ODC.

result.description:
Flexiforce Australia is seeking Process Workers to join our team on both day and afternoon shifts at our clients Moss Vale NSW facility. This is a casual position with full-time ongoing hours that play a vital role in our clients manufacturing and assembly operations. As a Process Worker, you will be instrumental in ensuring production lines run smoothly and efficiently, directly contributing to the quality of products and the success of our client's business. This role offers stability, hands-on work, and the opportunity to be part of a dedicated manufacturing team.

What you'll be doing

1.	Operating and monitoring production line machinery and equipment to ensure optimal performance
2.	Assembling products according to specifications and quality standards
3.	Inspecting finished products for quality control and identifying any defects or issues
4.	Preparing materials and components for processing stages
5.	Maintaining a clean and safe working environment in compliance with health and safety regulations
6.	Recording production data and reporting any equipment malfunctions or concerns to supervisors
7.	Following standard operating procedures and work instructions accurately
8.	Collaborating with team members to meet production targets and deadlines
9.	Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and providing feedback on processes

What we're looking for

1.	Previous experience in manufacturing, assembly or process work is highly desirable
2.	Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment and meet output targets
3.	Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality standards
4.	Reliability and punctuality, with flexibility to work day and afternoon shifts
5.	Physical capability to perform assembly work and operate machinery safely
6.	Willingness to follow instructions and work as part of a team
7.	Basic literacy and numeracy skills
8.	A valid working visa or Australian citizenship (where applicable)

What we offer

1.	Competitive hourly rates and ongoing employment security
2.	Shift allowances for afternoon shifts
3.	Safe, well-maintained working environment
4.	Opportunity to develop manufacturing and assembly skills
5.	Supportive team environment with experienced supervisors
6.	Career progression opportunities within the organisation
7.	Compliance with all relevant workplace entitlements and condition

Our client is a leading manufacturing company committed to delivering high-quality products and services. They pride themselves on maintaining a skilled workforce, fostering a culture of safety and continuous improvement, and building long-term relationships with their employees. Our clients Moss Vale facility is a hub of production and assembly operations where teamwork and efficiency are at the heart of everything they do. Our client is dedicated to providing a supportive workplace where employees can develop their skills and contribute meaningfully to their success.

Ready to join our team? Apply now to become a Process Worker at Flexiforce Australia.

If you meet the criteria and are ready to start, we want to hear from you ASAP.

result.description:
Next Gen Talent
Company: ASSISTIVE TECH SUPPLIERS PTY LTD
Position: Software Engineer
Location: 1/16 First Avenue, Broadbeach QLD, 4218 Australia
Salary: $120K to 130K + Super.

Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree or higher qualification with at least 3 years of experience as a Software Engineer.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Analyse business processes, workflows, and operational challenges to identify opportunities where Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) can deliver measurable business value and improve efficiency.
Manage cloud hosting infrastructure, application servers, development environments, and deployment platforms to ensure secure, reliable, and high-performing AI applications.
Design, develop, and deploy production-grade AI solutions using modern AI architectures, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), autonomous AI agents, vector databases, semantic search, and agent-to-agent communication frameworks.
Develop, deploy, and maintain Machine Learning models following MLOps best practices, including model lifecycle management, automated CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, performance monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and governance.
Build and integrate AI-powered applications using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, and other enterprise AI platforms alongside custom software development.
Conduct proof-of-concept (PoC) projects and prototype AI solutions within sandbox environments to evaluate emerging technologies, compare implementation approaches, and validate business outcomes.
Contribute to software solution architecture by designing scalable, secure, cloud-native AI systems that integrate with existing enterprise applications and data platforms.
Present technical findings, solution options, feasibility assessments, and strategic recommendations to senior management, project stakeholders, and both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure AI solutions comply with Responsible AI principles by implementing appropriate guardrails, explainability, transparency, human-in-the-loop decision processes, security controls, privacy requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web, cloud, and enterprise applications integrating AI/ML capabilities using modern software engineering practices.
Develop RESTful APIs, microservices, and secure integrations connecting AI services with enterprise applications, databases, and third-party platforms.
Optimise AI model performance, application scalability, cloud infrastructure utilisation, and operational reliability through continuous monitoring and performance tuning.
Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architectural diagrams, deployment procedures, and operational guides to support ongoing maintenance and knowledge sharing.

Skills & Attributes:
Good knowledge on software configuration management systems
Logical thinking and problem-solving skills along with an ability to collaborate.
Proficiency in troubleshooting software issues and debugging a large codebase.
Experience writing functional and technical documentation.
Act as a source of knowledge on best practice in the implementation of operational software systems.

How to Apply:
To apply for this role, please send your resume to info@nextgentalent.com.au. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted. All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

result.description:
Placed.au is looking for a full-time Functions Operations Manager for our client in Northcote, Victoria. This role is responsible for managing hospitality function operations, overseeing event delivery, ensuring operational excellence, and driving exceptional guest experiences across venues and external catering operations.

Job Description

•	Manage the day-to-day operations of function facilities at all venues and external catering functions, ensuring seamless delivery and high-quality guest experiences.

•	Develop and implement standard operating procedures for function execution across all venues, ensuring consistency in service, efficiency and compliance with hospitality standards.

•	Collaborate with event coordinators, senior management, and operational teams to ensure function execution aligns with business strategies, client expectations, and venue capabilities.

•	Ensure operational consistency and financial performance by auditing and refining function workflows, service delivery and venue capabilities.

•	Conduct venue performance reviews to assess function profitability and identify areas for improvement.

•	Ensure all venues remain compliant with hospitality regulations, licensing laws and risk management policies.

•	Review incident summary reports to determine areas of improvement for function safety and security.

•	Act as the primary escalation point for customer complaints and member queries, resolving concerns professionally to ensure customer satisfaction.

•	Collaborate with Head Chefs and sommeliers to develop menus and function packages that align with each venue’s identity, accommodate dietary requirements and maintain profitability.

•	Produce and analyse operational reports relevant to venue functions and provide advice on operational matters.

•	Monitor financial performance by managing budgets, forecasting revenue and analysing profitability for function operations, including food, beverage, labour and other costs.

•	Work closely with senior management and other departments to align operational strategies, enhance guest experience and achieve revenue goals.

•	Assist in creating and streamlining standardised procedures for tracking venue revenue and producing weekly, quarterly and yearly reports.

•	Stay updated on hospitality, events and tourism industry trends and apply insights to improve operations and guest experiences.

•	Oversee resource planning with the Event Coordinator and Head Chefs to ensure optimal staffing, food and beverage availability.

•	Oversee key supplier and client agreements to maintain cost-effective and high-quality function services.

•	Oversee staff training programs to enhance service excellence and function operations.
Qualifications / Attributes

•	Must hold a Diploma in Hospitality Management or a relevant field, or at least three (3) years of relevant work experience may substitute for the formal qualification.

•	Must possess at least one (1) year of relevant work experience in function operations, hospitality management, or a similar role.

•	Demonstrated success managing function operations within large-scale hospitality businesses.

•	Strong leadership, organisational and stakeholder management skills.

•	Excellent communication and customer service abilities.

•	Experience managing budgets, operational reporting and venue performance.

•	Passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences while driving operational success.

Salary Range

$75,000 – $90,000 per annum excluding superannuation.
